notes: Registration input, not a run input: daily bars for the 300 option-universe tickers, same recipe as source-stock-daily.json (ADR-0233 httpblobs; basis, transform, window 2016-01-01 .. 2026-10-01 and IRREGULAR-split flags are described there). The entity list is read from configs/option_universe_300.json key tickers (the rank output; never restated here); entities_file is absolute after $VAR expansion (export INDEX_OPTIONS_ROOT=<this child's root>) and entities_sha256 pins the file, so an edited universe refuses until the hash is updated deliberately. cache_dir is $STOCK_DAILY_300_RAW_ROOT, a separate raw root from the 116-ticker pull. max_refused 15 allows delisted or no-data tickers to land as refused inventory rows (the run records which and why); lower it once the real refusal count is known. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source stock-daily-bars-300 --catalog-source stock-daily-bars-300 --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-stock-daily-300.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source stock-daily-bars-300 --stream files --mode backfill.
